title: Synthetic Privacy and Data Governance Policy

sections.title: Data minimization and purpose limitation
sections.text: AI features must collect and retain only data necessary for the documented intended use. A launch owner must define retention, deletion, access, and prohibited secondary-use controls before production processing begins.

sections.title: Sensitive and biometric data
sections.text: Biometric, health, financial, precise location, and other sensitive data require explicit approval, documented consent or authority, restricted access, encryption, deletion procedures, and jurisdiction-specific review before launch.

sections.title: User content and model provider restrictions
sections.text: User content sent to a model provider must be covered by an approved processing purpose and provider agreement. The provider must not train on submitted content unless the user and organization have expressly authorized that use.
